opening.argument: The speaker identifies Strongcoin.biz and Coins Hour as scams the video is seeking to expose, not as opportunities to join. The warning is explicit: the speaker hopes to stop viewers from joining these types of systems, especially the two named. That framing makes the displayed investment plans and claimed returns objects of examination, not a recommendation to participate. The speaker also asks viewers to share the video to help prevent others from being caught. Taken together, the direct identification of the alleged scams and the warning against joining establish an anti-scam investigation rather than an investment solicitation.
